name: Project graph and task lifecycle
userOutcome: The user can inspect requirements, features, tasks, dependencies, readiness, review facets, and plan versions with deterministic explanations.
productionDataSource: SQLite project graph and event projections.
errorBehavior: Show the last committed graph when available and never display a more advanced state than persisted truth.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not use UI-only status mutations.
Do not discard historical plan versions.
acceptanceTests: Navigate a large graph through the accessible table.
